issues.areas: mail shell; contacts; calendar; attachment queries

issues.title: Complete folder management, favorites, colors and safe drag/drop
issues.architecture: none unless provider capability contract changes
criteria: Create/rename/move/delete supported folders; protect system/read-only folders and report permission failures.
Favorites and folder colors persist; arbitrary nesting and provider delimiters remain intact.
Drag/drop and bulk moves identify exact scope; undo only for a verified inverse; no operation on structural parents.

issues.title: Complete QuickText, templates and account-aware signature libraries
issues.architecture: gate for new signature-sync adapter
criteria: Searchable libraries support placeholders, cursor insertion, formatting and per-account defaults without mixing identities.
HTML/plaintext, tables, inline images, mentions and quoted reply headers survive draft round trips; unsupported features are explicit.
Gmail/Exchange signature synchronization is capability-gated, conflict-safe and independently tested; local libraries work offline.

issues.title: Complete scheduled send, undo-send and snooze lifecycle
issues.architecture: gate if durable lifecycle contract must change
criteria: Immediate, delayed and undo-send share documented durable transitions; undo is not recall after server acceptance.
Restart, suspend, DST, clock changes and overdue jobs produce visible, nonduplicating recovery; disclose app-running requirements.
Snooze returns to the right account/folder and survives moves; cancellation cannot falsely promise delivery prevention.

issues.title: Deliver reviewed personalized mass mail with per-recipient outcomes
issues.architecture: gate for bulk-send persistence model
criteria: Preview every personalized message and final recipient set before user submission; no hidden BCC or recipient-data leakage.
Invalid/missing placeholders and duplicate recipients are reported; cancellation and provider rate limits preserve per-recipient status.
Ambiguous delivery is never blindly retried; all automated delivery tests use controlled recipients.

issues.title: Add transparent inbox categories with user corrections and complete access
issues.architecture: gate for new classifier/data model
criteria: Provide configurable category tabs, manual correction and rule-based assignment with visible reasons.
All-mail remains available; unknown/unclassified messages are not silently omitted; counts explain partial coverage.
Assignments survive synchronization and restart without being confused with remote labels or optional people/service grouping.

issues.title: Add configurable Quick Action macros over reviewed message sets
issues.architecture: gate if new persistent macro model is needed
criteria: Compose supported ordered actions with preview, keyboard invocation and clear local/server runtime requirements.
Exact reviewed IDs are frozen; new arrivals are excluded; interrupted chains report per-step/per-message outcomes.
No macro silently escalates to external sends or unrecoverable deletes; reject recursive/unsupported chains.

issues.title: Deliver an all-attachments workspace and bounded content search
issues.architecture: gate before introducing a content-indexing service/dependency
criteria: Search/filter files by account, contact, name, type, date and size with source-message links and explicit downloaded coverage.
Preview/open/save supported files safely; deleted/moved mail and stale queries do not open a different file.
Content indexing requires an approved isolated, resource-bounded design; encrypted or unsupported formats are clearly marked, not fabricated as searchable.

issues.title: Implement provider-backed mail rules and vacation/forwarding capabilities
issues.architecture: gate for new provider adapters/permissions
criteria: Inventory then implement stable-target supported server filters, ordering and supported vacation/forwarding operations per provider.
Clearly distinguish always-on server rules from local rules; unsupported conditions cannot silently become broader rules.
Round-trip edits, conflict/revocation, loops, partial saves and server renames are tested; no real external forwarding is enabled by tests.

issues.title: Certify remote labels, categories and local annotations across workflows

criteria: Explicit links retain ADR-0002 account isolation and message/thread union semantics across move, sync and restart.
Verify local tags and provider categories in lists, search, compose and bulk actions; preserve name/color capabilities.
Inventory message annotations and flags against the stable reference; any new persistence requires a bounded documented slice.

Cancellation, expired/revoked consent, MFA/app-password guidance, certificate errors and partial service setup preserve recoverable state.
No plaintext secrets in logs; use Oreneta-owned OAuth registrations and explicit scopes before distributable provider certification.
